entrada.texto:
Simulation results and analysis
The proposed system, evaluated using MATLAB and Hyperledger Fabric, is not only efficient and reliable but 
also highly cost-effective. The system program functionality is contained in a smart contract, executed by Hyper-
Ledger Fabric using the Docker containers technique. This article’s testing setup is run in an Ubuntu 16.04 
Hyperledger Fabric, version 1.4 Docker 18.06 container, ensuring the system’s cost-effectiveness. As coalition 
peers, multiple nodes are hosted on one server computer, collaborating using the PoAh consensus mechanism 
to achieve agreements, further enhancing the system’s cost-effectiveness. Every node has 8-vCPUS at 2.0 GHz, 
contributing to the system’s high performance and cost-effectiveness. Virtual LAN cards with a speed of 1 Mbps 
are used to link VMs together, ensuring cost-effective communication. A single ordering service called a typical 
order is deployed, utilizing the suggested smart contract. Table 1 displays the expenses associated with calculation 
and communication throughout the authentication process, reaffirming the system’s cost-effectiveness.
Figure 4 illustrates that authentication times grow for varying numbers of peers deployed as terminal

resposta.resumo: Os autores apresentam uma arquitetura de computação de borda assistida por blockchain para IIoT, implementada em Hyperledger Fabric com consenso PoAh. Simulações em MATLAB mostram alta eficiência, confiabilidade e baixo custo, usando containers Docker e VMs conectadas por LAN de 1 Mbps. O tempo de autenticação aumenta conforme o número de nós (de 5 a 50), mas permanece eficiente. Os custos de cálculo e comunicação são detalhados, reforçando a viabilidade econômica da solução.
